Linear Regression 
 
 
DATASET: real estate valuation regression

Section A 
Answer the following questions (4 marks) 
1. How many samples are there? 
414 
2. How 
many 
input 
variables 
are 
there? 
6 
3. Which 
column 
is 
the 
output 
variable 
(target 
outcome)? 
Y= house price of unit area 
4. What 
does 
each 
of 
the 
input 
columns 
mean? 
X1=the transaction date  
X2=the house age  
X3=the distance to the nearest MRT station  
X4=the number of convenience stores in the living circle on foot  
X5=the geographic coordinate, latitude.  
X6=the geographic coordinate, longitude.

1. Using the scatter plots between each of the input features (X1-X4) and the 
output (Y), which input variable, do you think, is better in predicting the output 
/ target variable? (4 marks) 
 
 
The input variable X3 (the distance to the Nearest MRT Station) is better in 
predicting the output / target variable (house price of unit area) 
 
2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in dataset? (1 
mark) 
 
 
3. What is the train test split ratio that you have chosen? (1 mark)

80:20 Split: approximately 80% of the data is assigned to the training set, while 
the remaining 20% forms the test set. 
 
4. Evaluate the linear regression model by computing the MAE, MSE and 
Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).(3 marks) 
 
 
 
 
5. What are the 3 new things that you learned after you completed this 
assignment? 
 
• Calculate Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) 
• 80:20 Train Test set split ratio 
• Plotting regression line model
